evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上: FY2025(9月期)10-K『REPORTABLE SEGMENT DATA』NJNG(規制ガス配給) $1,301,496千=63.9% / ES(Energy Services・卸ガストレーディング) $453,457千=22.3% / CEV(Clean Energy Ventures・太陽光) $112,501千=5.5% / S&T(Storage & Transportation) $106,372千=5.2% / Corporate and other $61,424千=3.0%（総営業収益 $2,036,412千）。セグメント純利益では NJNG $213,541千=63.6% / CEV $61,156千=18.2% / ES $40,878千=12.2% / S&T $18,541千=5.5%。構造的な参入障壁を持つのはNJNG（BPU規制下の配給網＝dom根拠参照）とS&T(FERC規制のLeaf River/Adelphia Gateway)の2つだが、S&Tは5.2%で15%に届かない。ESは卸ガスの物理・金融トレーディングで参入障壁なし、CEVは補助金依存の太陽光開発で障壁なし＝堀とは数えない。→ 独立した堀は1本。ただし需要家は約589,000件の住宅・商業に分散し単一顧客10%以上の開示なし、単一事業(NJNG)は63.9%で70%未満。→ 単一事業だが用途・顧客が分散 = 70。出典: SEC 10-K CIK0000356309 acc 0000356309-25-000093 (2025-11-20), R45.htm
evidence.dom: チョークポイント＝NJNGのガス配給網。FY2025 10-K Item1 Competition『Although its franchises are nonexclusive, NJNG is not currently subject to competition from other natural gas distribution utilities with regard to the transportation of natural gas in its service territory』＝自社サービステリトリー(Burlington/Middlesex/Monmouth/Morris/Ocean/Sussexの6郡)内のガス配給シェアは実質100%。配給(託送)はBPU規制下の独占で、需要家は供給元(コモディティ)は選べても配給網は選べない。→ 独占≥90% = 100。【但し書き】この100%はNJNGセグメント(売上の63.9%・純利益の63.6%)に対する値。ES(22.3%)は卸トレーディングでシェア支配なし、CEV(5.5%)も競争的。またNJNGの需要家約589,000件はニュージャージー州全体のガス需要家約290万件の約2割であり、州全体を市場と定義すれば約20%になる。門の定義『チョークポイントの占有率』に従い自社フランチャイズ領域を市場と取った。出典: SEC 10-K CIK0000356309 acc 0000356309-25-000093 (2025-11-20) Item 1. BUSINESS - Competition
evidence.irr: irr=100(唯一供給)。10-K Item1 Competition:『Although its franchises are nonexclusive, NJNG is not currently subject to competition from other natural gas distribution utilities with regard to the transportation of natural gas in its service territory. Due to significant distances between NJNG's current large industrial customers and the nearest interstate natural gas pipelines, as well as the availability of its transportation tariff, NJNG currently does not believe it has significant exposure to the risk that its distribution system will be bypassed.』さらにEDECAで小売の商品供給は自由化済だが『NJNG earns Utility Gross Margin through the delivery of natural gas to its customers, regardless of whether it or a third-party supplier provides the wholesale natural gas commodity.』＝顧客が供給業者を替えても配送の対価はNJNGに帰属＝配送の代替供給者が存在しない。反証も記録:『franchises are nonexclusive』かつ『Competition does exist from suppliers of oil, electricity and propane.』(＝同一サービスの代替供給者ではなく燃料間の需要代替)。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/356309/000035630925000093/njr-20250930.htm
evidence.rep: rep=100(複製不能・数十年級)。10-K Item2 Properties:『As of September 30, 2025, NJNG owns approximately 7,486 miles of distribution main, 7,917 miles of service main and 245 miles of transmission main, and operates more than 610,000 meters. Mains are primarily located under public roads. Where mains are located under private property, NJNG has obtained easements from the owners of record.』計15,648マイルの埋設管網＋公道下占用と私有地地役権。貸借対照表『Utility plant, at cost $4,434,220』(千ドル=44.3億ドル・簿価は数十年の累積取得原価)＋『NJNG's total capital expenditures spent or accrued during fiscal 2025 were approximately $450.1M』。BPU認可の料金基盤(『an overall rate of return on rate base of 7.08%, return on common equity of 9.6%』)下でしか回収できず、並行網の敷設は経済的に不成立(前掲bypass記述)。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/356309/000035630925000093/njr-20250930.htm
evidence.dur: dur=100(規制/物理型)。10-K:『New Jersey Natural Gas Company (“NJNG”), a subsidiary of the Company, is a regulated gas distribution company and is subject to regulation by the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities (the “BPU”).』堀の源泉はブランドでもネットワーク効果でもスイッチングコストでもなく、BPU規制フランチャイズ＋公道下の物理埋設資産(15,648マイルの本管・610,000超のメーター)。2024-11-21 BPU命令で$157.0Mの基本料金引上げ承認＝料金決定が規制で担保。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/356309/000035630925000093/njr-20250930.htm
